body:
## What this rental listing is

GetRentacar's Italy catalog (`https://getrentacar.com/en-US/italy`) lists **455 cars available for rent in Italy** from local fleet operators and individual owners. When reviewed on 29 October 2026, the page highlighted major airport and urban pickup hubs including **Rome Fiumicino (FCO), Rome Ciampino (CIA), Milan Malpensa (MXP), Milan Linate (LIN), Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY), and Turin Caselle (TRN)**.

## Verified vehicles and unlimited-mileage rates

Notably, all 12 featured vehicle cards on the Italy landing page on 29 October 2026 included **Unlimited mileage** and GetRentacar's **Car guarantee**:

- **Opel Crossland X (2020 model, listing `#5059140`):** Compact crossover at **US$ 136 per day** with unlimited mileage.
- **Jeep Compass (2020 model, listing `#5059138`):** Compact SUV rated **4.3 out of 5** (1 trip), listed at **US$ 142 per day** with unlimited mileage.
- **Renault Megane (2019, `#5059135`), Ford KA (2020, `#5059134`), and Volkswagen Touareg (2013, `#5059139`):** Each listed at **US$ 142 per day** with unlimited mileage.
- **Fiat Panda (2020 model, listing `#5059133`):** Classic Italian city car at **US$ 147 per day** with unlimited mileage.
- **Lancia Ypsilon (2020, `#5059131`) & Toyota Agya (2019, `#5059132`):** Each listed at **US$ 149 per day** with unlimited mileage.
- **Toyota Yaris (2020, `#5059136`, rated 4.5) & Smart Fortwo (2020, `#5059137`):** Each listed at **US$ 161 per day** with unlimited mileage.

Across the broader 455-car Italian inventory, the brand filters show 40 Fiats, 40 Audis, 30 Mercedes-Benz vehicles, 22 Fords, 22 Volkswagens, 18 Opels, 16 Peugeots, 13 Jeeps, 13 Skodas, and 12 Toyotas.

## Payment terms and driver eligibility

Per the Italy FAQ on the listing:

- **Debit card booking:** MasterCard and VISA debit cards are accepted, with **15% paid online** at reservation and **85% paid directly to the owner** at vehicle pickup (or 100% online where enabled).
- **Minimum age & documents:** Renters must be at least **18 years old** (higher rates apply under age 25) and hold a valid passport plus a local or international driving licence.

## What to check before booking

Verify the specific car's security deposit requirement, insurance coverage tier, and pickup meeting instructions before paying the non-refundable 15% booking fee.
